## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō Módēng nǚ jiěxíng zhōng liùshì jīng* (T552) is a one-fascicle anonymous short sūtra parallel to [KR6i0182](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0182) (T551) by Ān Shìgāo. The two preserve different recensions of the same Mātaṅga narrative.

**Abstract**

A parallel recension to [KR6i0182](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0182). The "six matters in the body" of the title refers to a Buddhist contemplative analysis of the body's constituents that the Buddha uses to redirect the Mātaṅga woman's attachment to Ānanda's body. Standard pre-Sui anonymous *shīyì* attribution.
